cards.claim: James Tilley is a footballer who played in a match for Crawley Reds against QPR.
cards.quote: James Tilley is enjoying a new role at Crawley . The former Albion wideman impressed in a more central berth as Reds came from three down to draw 3-3 at home to QPR . His goal kick-started the comeback against Championship opponents . Reds boss Kevin Betsy said : “ Tilley has played really well in pre-season and popped up in the No.8 role today with a really good strike . “ He ’ s a really nice footballer in and out of possession .
